en.t: BJP chalks out 22-day programme to highlight ‘failures’ of Congress-led Karnataka government before facing zilla, taluk panchayat polls in Dakshina Kannada
en.s: The BJP, which held sway over the zilla panchayat and taluk panchayats in Dakshina Kannada in the last two terms, has begun preparing the ground to retain its hold over the local bodies in the coming elections.

en.t: Foundation stone for Puttur govt. medical college will be laid ahead of ZP and TP polls: MLA
en.s: Foundation stone for Puttur Government Medical College to be laid before polls, with bids soon, plus regional development plans and public programs.

en.t: Yenepoya to present honorary doctorate to Kanthapuram A.P. Aboobacker Musliar on October 24
en.s: Yenepoya University will confer honorary doctorate to Kanthapuram A.P. Aboobacker Musliar at its 16th convocation on Oct 24.

en.t: First PU student dies in accident on Mangaluru-Bengaluru National Highway
en.s: Tragic accident on Mangaluru-Bengaluru NH claims 16-year-old Anvin Jojo George; car hits stationary gas tanker; father injured.
Tragic drowning of 21-year-old nursing student Keerthan near Dharmasthala while visiting home, after being swept away by river current.

Shon Mascarenhas got electrocuted when he went to dry clothes on a rope in the backyard of the house that had come in contact with a live wire. His mother got electrocuted when she tried to rescue Shon.

en.t: Woman held for snatching chain from child
en.s: Woman arrested for snatching a 1.35 lakh gold chain from a 3-year-old at a wedding venue in Mangaluru; linked to multiple theft cases.

en.t: Accident turns into murder, Mangaluru police arrest man for death of two
en.s: Mangaluru police arrest Hafeez for murder after he allegedly rammed a scooter, killing two men amid a phone dispute.

en.t: MCC clears 828 pending e-khata applications during special drive
en.s: MCC clears 828 of 3,774 pending e-khata applications in a four-day drive; another drive planned to finish remaining cases.

en.t: Police department should fulfill needs of martyrs’ family members, says Dakshina Kannada judge
en.s: Dakshina Kannada judge urges police to meet martyrs’ families’ needs during a Police Commemoration Day ceremony honoring fallen officers.

en.t: Curtains down on Dasara fervour in coastal belt
en.s: Dasara celebrations across Karnataka's coastal belt ended with massive temple processions, cultural programs, and festive tourism in Mangaluru and Udupi.

en.t: Commissioning Mangaladevi bus terminal hangs in balance on road divider issue
en.s: Debate over installing road dividers stalls Mangaladevi bus terminal’s use, balancing traffic relief with chariot festival accessibility.

en.t: Mangalore University establishes dedicated experimental facility for iodine aerosol research to advance nuclear safety
en.s: Mangalore University has set up the country’s first dedicated experimental facility for iodine aerosol generation and characterisation.

en.t: Special trains between Thiruvananthapuram North and Mangaluru on October 20th and 21st
en.s: South Western Railway operates two express special trains between Thiruvananthapuram North and Mangaluru Junction on Oct 20-21 to handle festival-season rush.

en.t: Mangaluru Dasara procession to begin at 4 p.m. on October 21, end at 6 a.m. on October 22
en.s: Police Commissioner Sudheer Kumar Reddy said that, for public safety, people are advised to avoid the procession route and use alternative routes.

en.t: Priest accused of sexually harassing minor boys arrested
en.s: Mangaluru police have arrested priest Siprian Pinto of St. Vincent Ferrar Church in Valencia over allegations of aggravated sexual assault involving five 14-year-old boys.

kn.t: ಮಂಗಳೂರು | ಹೊಯ್ಗೆಬಜಾರ್ ಬಳಿ 3 ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ ಹೋಟೆಲ್‌ ಪ್ರವಾಸಿ ಸೌಕರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಜಲಸಾರಿಗೆ ಮಂಡಳಿಯಿಂದ ₹60 ಕೋಟಿ ಯೋಜನೆ Last Updated 23 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2026, 7:50 IST
kn.s: ನಗರದ ಹೊಯ್ಗೆ ಬಜಾರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಲೈಟ್‌ಹೌಸ್ (ದೀಪಸ್ತಂಭ) ಪ್ರದೇಶವನ್ನು ಪ್ರವಾಸೋದ್ಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಆತಿಥ್ಯ ವಲಯವಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸಲು 3 ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ ಹೋಟೆಲ್‌ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಖಾಸಗಿ ಸಹಭಾಗಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಷ್ಠಾನಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಜಲಸಾರಿಗೆ ಮಂಡಳಿಯು ರೂಪರೇಷೆಯನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿದೆ.

kn.t: ಮಂಗಳೂರು ದಸರಾ: ಶಾರದೆ ಜಲಸ್ತಂಭನ; ಭಾವುಕ ಭಕ್ತರ ಮನ ಗಣೇಶೋತ್ಸವದ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಾಪಿಸಿದ ಗಣಪತಿ ಮೂರ್ತಿಯ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಗೂ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾದ ಭಕ್ತರು Last Updated 23 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2026, 5:47 IST
kn.s: Sharada Idol Immersion: ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಕುದ್ರೋಳಿ ಗೋಕರ್ಣನಾಥೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ನವದುರ್ಗೆಯರು ಹಾಗೂ ಶಾರದಾ ವಿಗ್ರಹಗಳ ಶೋಭಾಯಾತ್ರೆ ನಂತರ ಭಾವಪೂರ್ಣ ಜಲಸ್ತಂಭನ ನೆರವೇರಿತು.
